existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `Specimen` has material R4->R6 breaking changes despite stable artifact identity. The top migration concerns are the container remodel with required `device[x]`, CodeableReference wire-shape changes for body site/additive, and the accession/processing path changes. The main uncertainty is not whether the structural breaks exist, but how official guidance intends legacy container and processing terminology to map.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration needs explicit transforms for removed or renamed properties (`accessionIdentifier`, container children, `processing.procedure`) and structural wrapping for CodeableReference paths. R6 also adds richer semantics (`focus`, `combined`, `role`, `feature`, Procedure/device/performer workflow fields) that should be preserved with extensions or accepted loss when downgrading to R4. Validators and generated models must be regenerated rather than reused because several same-looking paths now expose different datatypes.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for StructureDefinition-level element presence, cardinality, type, target, binding-strength, and invariant findings because both primary StructureDefinitions were available and compared directly. Confidence is medium for terminology/rationale details where SNOMED expansions, official diffs, and cross-version ConceptMaps were not available in the supplied inputs.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Specimen keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 5 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 4 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 68/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Specimen.processing.procedure was replaced by Specimen.processing.method with a different example value set
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: populated R4 `processing.procedure` is an undefined R6 child; runtime/API/codegen references to the old property also break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Specimen.container was remodeled: several R4 subelements were removed and R6 requires container.device[x]
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: removed child elements are unknown in R6, and each R6 container now requires a `device[x]` value that old instances did not need.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Specimen.accessionIdentifier was removed and folded into Specimen.identifier
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 instance with `accessionIdentifier` uses an element R6 no longer defines; generated models also lose the dedicated property.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Specimen.collection.bodySite changed from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(BodyStructure)
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `bodySite.coding` or `bodySite.text` is not the R6 CodeableReference shape; R6 BodyStructure references create R6-to-R4 loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Specimen.processing.additive changed from Reference(Substance) to CodeableReference(Substance or SubstanceDefinition)
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 array items with direct Reference fields are not the R6 CodeableReference shape; concept-only and SubstanceDefinition R6 additives are lossy to R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Specimen.subject semantics were narrowed to subject-of-record and R6 adds Specimen.focus for the actual collection source
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: unchanged R4 instances may still validate, but their intended meaning can shift; R6 `focus` also creates R6-to-R4 semantic loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Several common clinical search codes split into code/reference variants or changed type because elements became CodeableReference-like
topFindings.whyRelevant: Behavior/API finding whose affectedResources include this resource, or shared context when listed under sharedBehaviorContext.

topFindings.title: R6 expands collection/processing workflow detail and reference targets beyond R4 representability
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R4 validators and models cannot carry the new device, performer, collector-target, or processing Duration representations without extensions or external resources.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds Specimen.collection.procedure and local invariant spm-1 forbids using it with collection.collector
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: none: the invalid combination requires a new R6-only element; old R4 collector-only data is still valid.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds Specimen.combined, Specimen.role, and Specimen.feature, which are not representable in base R4
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: base R4 has no equivalent elements for grouped/pooled status, specimen role, or structured feature annotations.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
